Every sound is a real recording, trimmed & level-matched: crowd reactions, snare, gong, bugle & whistle from Freesound and Wikimedia Commons (CC0 / public domain); Sad Trombone by Joe Lamb via SoundBible (CC BY 3.0).
The 87 sounds added in the big expansion came from Wikimedia Commons, SoundBible and OpenGameArt (all public domain / CC0 / CC BY — no ripped audio). Full credits for every new sound:
